_comment: Illustrative starting points, not measured device data.
A preset only fills the parameter boxes on the measurement pages. It is
never consulted during validation, so a preset cannot raise a limit or
talk a protocol past a safety check - editing this file can waste a run,
but it cannot make an unsafe one.
Replace these with your own stacks. The values below are deliberately
conservative: low amplitude, microsecond pulses, few cycles. Start there
on an unknown device and work up.

presets.name: Example: threshold switch
presets.role: volatile threshold switching, neuron and selector

presets.name: Example: ferroelectric capacitor
presets.stack: oxide electrode / ferroelectric film / oxide electrode

presets.name: Example: antiferroelectric capacitor
presets.stack: oxide electrode / antiferroelectric film / oxide electrode
presets.role: double hysteresis loop, AFE-PUND, energy storage
